title: Martin Pichlmair - Ancient Roguelikes: The Pre-History of Roguelike Games
speaker: Martin Pichlmair
talk_title: Ancient Roguelikes: The Pre-History of Roguelike Games
description: Roguelikes existed before Rogue. How can that be? You see, all inventions are just manifestations of ideas that are already in the room. Rogue was the culmination of a lot of previous ideas in the shape of a digital artifact. This talk takes you on a worldwide journey back in time to ancient forms of procedurally generation, tracing some roots of the games we play nowadays.
